release_row_hints.review_notes: Primary figure evidence supports the mature BacCH91 letter sequence, but the peptide is a lantibiotic with modified residues; database sequence fields encode the plain one-letter sequence and do not normalize the modifications. Broad Gram-positive/anti-Gram+ database activity is supported by Table 2 and the antibacterial activity section, with the primary-source limitation that L. lactis is reported as >100 µM and Gram-negative targets are inactive at the tested maximum.
